test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What type of political party system does India have?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Multi-party system**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India is a **democratic country** and every person has an **equal right **to express themselves.
 
• India have a **multi-party system**.
 
• **More than two parties** have a reasonable chance of coming to power either on their own strength or in alliance with others.
 
• People can **elect** their representative according to their choice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In **one-party system**, only **one party** is allowed to control and run the government. for eg- **China**
 
• In **second-party system**, only **two main parties **are allowed to run the government. for eg- **United States of America**
